test_name: Verify Contact Us Form Submission with Valid Data
description: This scenario tests the submission of the Contact Us form with valid user inputs and ensures the form is correctly processed.
steps: Locate the 'Name *' input field using its stable selector and type 'John Doe'.
Locate the 'Email *' input field using its stable selector and type 'john.doe@example.com'.
Locate the 'Comment or Message *' textarea using its stable selector and type 'I would like to inquire about bulk orders.'
Locate the 'SEND MESSAGE' button using its stable selector and click on it.
Verify that a success message or confirmation appears indicating the form submission was successful.
expected_results: All input fields accept valid data.
The 'SEND MESSAGE' button triggers the form submission.
A confirmation message is displayed indicating the form submission was successful.
edge_cases: Invalid email formats such as 'john.doe.com' or 'john.doe@.com'.
Exceeding the character limit for the 'Comment or Message *' field.
Double-clicking the 'SEND MESSAGE' button results in duplicate submissions.
data_requirements: Valid comment or message text such as 'I would like to inquire about bulk orders.'
No special characters in input fields other than allowed ones.
Ensure the form is accessible for testing purposes.
dependencies: The Contact Us page must be accessible.
The 'SEND MESSAGE' button must be functional.
The backend server must properly handle the form submission.
The success message element must be implemented.
The form fields must have proper validation rules in place.
api_interactions: Monitor the POST request for form submission.
Verify the server response status code (e.g., 200 for success).
Check if any validation API is used for email or message inputs.
performance_metrics: Ensure the page does not freeze during or after form submission.
Monitor server response time after form submission.
accessibility_requirements: Ensure all form fields have appropriate labels and ARIA roles.
Verify the 'SEND MESSAGE' button is accessible via keyboard navigation.
Check color contrast ratios for the form fields and button.
Ensure the success message is announced by screen readers.
Validate that the form can be completed without a mouse.
